```{r setup, include=FALSE}
### Permutative t-test function
perm_twogp_t <- function(values,
                         gp1_ind,
                         perm=999,
                         seed=1231) {
  
  ## values: vector of distance
  ## gp1_ind: boolean vector indicating gp1
  ## number of permutation
  ## seed
  
  ## observed t
  obs_t <- t.test(values[gp1_ind], values[!gp1_ind])$statistic
  
  ## set seed
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ## perm t vector
  perm_t_vec <- numeric(perm)
  
  ## permutation
  for (i in 1:perm){
    perm_gp1_ind <- sample(gp1_ind,
                           length(gp1_ind),
                           replace=FALSE)
    
    perm_t_vec[i] <- 
      t.test(values[perm_gp1_ind], values[!perm_gp1_ind])$statistic
    
  }
  
  perm_p_val <- (sum(abs(perm_t_vec) >= abs(obs_t)) + 1) / (perm + 1)
  
  perm_p_val
  
}



```

### Alpha diversity

#### Load and clean data
```{r DASH - read microbiome alpha diversity data, include=T}

## file path
MICROBIOME_ALPHA_DIVERSITY_LAB_DASH = "../data/alpha_diversity_lab_ana_data.tsv"

## read 
alpha_diversity_diet_DASH <- read.table(MICROBIOME_ALPHA_DIVERSITY_LAB_DASH, header=T, sep="\t") %>%
  mutate(diet = factor(diet, levels=c("baseline", "CH","CL","DH","DL")),
         visit = factor(visit, levels=c("PRI", "FP1", "FP2", "FP3", "FP4")),
         DASH = factor(DASH, c("baseline","DASH diet","Comparison diet")),
         sodium = factor(sodium, c("baseline","low sodium","high sodium"))) %>%
  arrange(pptid, visit)

```

#### Change of metrics from baseline
```{r DASH - alpha diversity change from baseline, include=TRUE}

## subset baseline alpha diversity data
alpha_diversity_diet_baseline_DASH <- 
  alpha_diversity_diet_DASH %>% filter(diet == "baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(c(pptid,observed_otus:shannon)) %>%
  melt(id.vars=c("pptid"),
       variable.name="metrics",
       value.name="baseline") 

## end-of-diet-period alpha diveristy data with baseline
### transform to long
alpha_diversity_diet_withbaseline_DASH <- alpha_diversity_diet_DASH %>% 
  filter(pptid %in% alpha_diversity_diet_baseline_DASH$pptid) %>% 
  filter(diet != "baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(c(pptid,visit,diet,DASH,sodium,
                  observed_otus:shannon)) %>%
  melt(id.vars=c("pptid","visit","diet","DASH","sodium"),
       variable.name="metrics",
       value.name="measurements")

## merge baseline with end-of-diet-period data
## calculate change from baseline
alpha_diversity_diet_changebaseline_DASH <- 
  merge(alpha_diversity_diet_withbaseline_DASH,
        alpha_diversity_diet_baseline_DASH,
        by=c("pptid","metrics"), all.x=T) %>%
  mutate(changefrombaseline = (measurements-baseline)) %>%
  dcast(pptid+visit+diet+DASH+sodium ~ metrics,
        value.var="changefrombaseline")



```

#### Alpha diversity model
```{r DASH - alpha diversity modeling - change from baseline, include=T}

## shannon
### lmer model with diet and period as fixed effect
alpha_shannon_changebaseline_DASH <- 
  lmer(shannon ~ diet + (1|pptid) + visit,
       data=alpha_diversity_diet_changebaseline_DASH,
       REML=TRUE)

### get emmeans object to average period effect
alpha_shannon_changebaseline_marginalmeans_DASH <- 
  emmeans(alpha_shannon_changebaseline_DASH,
          ~ diet, lmer.df ="satterthwaite")


### calculate estimates for contrasts
alpha_shannon_changebaseline_mean_sum_DASH <- 
  summary(contrast(
    alpha_shannon_changebaseline_marginalmeans_DASH,
    method=list("DASH4D diet vs baseline" = c(0,0,0.5,0.5),
                "DASH4D diet vs baseline among low sodium" = c(0,0,0,1),
                "DASH4D diet vs baseline among high sodium" = c(0,0,1,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline" = c(0.5,0.5,0,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline among low sodium" = c(0,1,0,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline among high sodium" = c(1,0,0,0),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet" = c(-0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among low sodium" = c(0,-1,0,1),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among high sodium" = c(-1,0,1,0),
                "Difference in DASH4D effect in low sodium vs high sodium" = c(1,-1,-1,1),
                "low sodium vs baseline" = c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5),
                "high sodium vs baseline" = c(0.5,0,0.5,0),
                "low sodium vs high sodium" = c(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5)
                )
    )
    ) %>%
  mutate(lb = estimate - qt(0.975, df=df)*SE,
         ub = estimate + qt(0.975, df=df)*SE)

### lmer model with diet and period as fixed effect
```

#### Check carry-over effect
```{r alpha diversity modeling (from baseline) - period or carry-over effect, include=T}


## create lag diet to check carry-over effect
alpha_diversity_diet_changebaseline_carryover <- 
  alpha_diversity_diet_changebaseline_DASH %>%
  arrange(pptid, visit) %>% group_by(pptid) %>%
  mutate(lagdiet = lag(diet)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(lagCH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CH",1,0),
         lagCL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CL",1,0),
         lagDH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DH",1,0),
         lagDL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DL",1,0))


## LR test to check inclusion of carry-over effect
alpha_shannon_changebaseline_DASH_base <- 
  lmer(shannon ~ diet + (1|pptid) + visit,
       data=alpha_diversity_diet_changebaseline_carryover,
       REML=FALSE)

alpha_shannon_changebaseline_DASH_carryover <- 
  lmer(shannon ~ diet + (1|pptid) + lagCH + lagCL + lagDH + lagDL + visit,
       data=alpha_diversity_diet_changebaseline_carryover,
       REML=FALSE)


anova(alpha_shannon_changebaseline_DASH_carryover,
      alpha_shannon_changebaseline_DASH_base)



```


### Beta diversity

#### Prepare data for beta diversity
```{r prepare data for beta diversity, include=T}


## metadata with baseline
metadata_withbaseline <-
  alpha_diversity_diet_DASH %>% 
  mutate(DASH = factor(DASH),
         visit= factor(visit))

## Rarefied data
### read rarefied data
RAREFIED_TAB <-
  "../data/species_included_clean_rarefied.tsv"
rarefied_species_tab <-
  read.table(RAREFIED_TAB, sep="\t", header=T, row.names=1)

### subset rarefied species data with baseline
rarefied_species_included <- 
  rarefied_species_tab[metadata_withbaseline$sample_id,]



## Filtered data
### read filtered data
SPECIES_FILTERED <- 
  "../data/species_included_filtered_DASH.tsv"
species_filtered_tab <- read.table(SPECIES_FILTERED,
                                   header=T,
                                   sep="\t",
                                   row.names=1)

### subset filtered species data with baseline
species_filtered_included <-
  species_filtered_tab[metadata_withbaseline$sample_id,]


### read taxonomy file
TAXONOMY <- 
  "../data/taxonomy.tsv"
taxonomy <- read.table(TAXONOMY,
                       header=T,
                       sep="\t") %>%
  mutate(genus = str_extract(Taxon, "g__.*(?=;)"),
         family = str_extract(Taxon, "f__.*?(?=;)"),
         Feature.ID = str_replace_all(Feature.ID, " ","."),
         Feature.ID = str_replace_all(Feature.ID, "-","."))


### merge subspecies into species (e.g. F.prausnitzii A ---> F.prausnitzii)
#### species clades merge
species_name = colnames(species_filtered_tab)

#### species with suffix
species_suffix_df = data.frame(subspecies = 
                              species_name[str_detect(species_name, "\\.[A-Z]$")]) %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace(subspecies, "\\.[A-Z]$", "")) %>%
  filter(species %in% species_name)

#### merge species with suffix into species
species_filtered_merged <- species_filtered_tab %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(species_suffix_df$subspecies,species_suffix_df$species)) %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("oldname") %>%
  mutate(newname = str_replace(oldname, "\\.[A-Z]$", "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-oldname) %>% group_by(newname) %>%
  summarise_all(., sum) %>% ungroup() %>%
  column_to_rownames("newname") %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame()

#### get the merged species table
species_filtered_clean <- 
  cbind(species_filtered_merged,
        species_filtered_tab %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(species_suffix_df$subspecies,species_suffix_df$species)))


#### subset filtered species data with baseline
species_filtered_clean_included <-
  species_filtered_clean[metadata_withbaseline$sample_id,]
 
```


#### Check within-individual correlation
```{r within-individual and diet/visit effect comparison, include=T}


## Bray-Curtis
### Calculate distance matrix on RARIFIED DATA
dist_mat_bc <- 
  vegdist(rarefied_species_included, method="bray")

### Convert distance matrix to pairwise data
dist_mat_bc_pair <-
  melt(as.matrix(dist_mat_bc))[melt(upper.tri(as.matrix(dist_mat_bc)))$value,]%>%
  filter(Var1 != Var2)

### Merge pairwise distance data with metadata
dist_mat_bc_pair_meta <-
  merge(
    merge(dist_mat_bc_pair,
          metadata_withbaseline %>% 
            dplyr::select(sample_id, pptid, diet, visit,DASH,sodium),
          by.x="Var1", by.y="sample_id", all.x=T),
    metadata_withbaseline %>% 
            dplyr::select(sample_id, pptid, diet, visit,DASH,sodium),
    by.x="Var2", by.y="sample_id", all.x=T)


### Within individual vs diet
ind_diet_bc_comp <-
  dist_mat_bc_pair_meta %>%
  mutate(group = factor(case_when(pptid.x == pptid.y ~ 0,
                                  diet.x == diet.y ~ 1),
                        labels=c("Within-individual", "Within-diet"))
         ) %>% filter(!is.na(group))


### Permutative t test: compare within-individual BC vs within-diet BC
bc_diet_ind_diet_permp <- perm_twogp_t(ind_diet_bc_comp$value,
                                       ind_diet_bc_comp$group == "Within-individual",
                                       perm=999,
                                       seed=1231)

### Within individual vs visit
ind_visit_bc_comp <-
  dist_mat_bc_pair_meta %>%
  mutate(group = factor(case_when(pptid.x == pptid.y ~ 0,
                                  visit.x == visit.y ~ 1),
                        labels=c("Within-individual", "Within-visit"))
         ) %>% filter(!is.na(group))


### Permutative t test: compare within-individual BC vs within-visit BC
bc_visit_ind_visit_permp <- perm_twogp_t(ind_visit_bc_comp$value,
                                       ind_visit_bc_comp$group == "Within-individual",
                                       perm=999,
                                       seed=1231)


### export BC distance data for visualization
ind_covariates_bc_comp_df <-
  rbind(ind_visit_bc_comp %>% dplyr::select(group, value),
        ind_diet_bc_comp %>% 
          filter(group == 'Within-diet') %>% 
          dplyr::select(group, value))


write.table(ind_covariates_bc_comp_df,
            "../intermediate/microbiome/ind_covariates_bc_comp_df.tsv",
            sep="\t",
            row.names=T,
            quote=F)
```

#### PCA on CLR-transformed change from baseline
```{r pca on clr-transformed change, include=T}

set.seed(890122)


## impute with cmultRepl
species_filtered_clean_included_impute <-
  cmultRepl(species_filtered_clean_included,
            method="GBM",
            z.warning=0.3,
            z.delete = F,
            output='p-counts')[metadata_withbaseline$sample_id,]


## clr transformation
species_filtered_clean_included_impute_clr <-
  decostand(species_filtered_clean_included_impute,
            method="clr",
            pseudocount=0)[metadata_withbaseline$sample_id,]

dist_mat_ratchison <- 
  dist(species_filtered_clean_included_impute_clr)

### Convert distance matrix to pairwise data

  filter(Var1 != Var2)

                                  diet.x == diet.y ~ 1),

dist_baseline_ratchison <-
  dist_mat_ratchison_pair_meta %>% filter(pptid.x == pptid.y & visit.x == "PRI")

rownames(metadata_withbaseline) <-
  metadata_withbaseline$sample_id


### CLR value change from baseline
make_displacements <- function(Z, meta,
                               subject   = "subject",
                               treatment = "diet",
                               visit     = "visit",
                               baseline  = "PRI") {

  stopifnot(identical(rownames(Z), rownames(meta)))
  stopifnot(all(c(subject, visit) %in% colnames(meta)))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(Z)))

  subj <- as.character(meta[[subject]])
  trt <- as.character(meta[[treatment]])
  vis  <- as.character(meta[[visit]])
  stopifnot(baseline %in% vis)

  # baseline row index per subject; NA if absent
  base_idx <- match(subj, subj[vis == baseline])
  base_row <- which(vis == baseline)[base_idx]

  keep <- vis != baseline & !is.na(base_row)

  V <- Z[keep, , drop = FALSE] - Z[base_row[keep], , drop = FALSE]

  key <- data.frame(
    sample_id = rownames(Z)[keep],
    subject   = subj[keep],
    visit     = vis[keep],
    diet = trt[keep],
    base_id   = rownames(Z)[base_row[keep]],
    norm      = sqrt(rowSums(V^2)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(V) <- key$sample_id

  # report what was dropped
  lost <- setdiff(unique(subj), unique(subj[vis == baseline]))
  if (length(lost))
    warning(sprintf("%d subject(s) lacking a %s sample dropped: %s",
                    length(lost), baseline, paste(lost, collapse = ", ")))

  list(V = V, key = key)
}


out <- make_displacements(as.matrix(species_filtered_clean_included_impute_clr),
                          metadata_withbaseline,
                          subject = "pptid")

out_mat <- out$V


### Align pc signs
align_pc_sign <- function(pca, X) {
  # drop zero-variance columns: scale() would return NaN
  X <- X[, apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]

  # rows of X must match rows of pca$x
  if (!is.null(rownames(pca$x)) && !is.null(rownames(X)))
    X <- X[rownames(pca$x), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == nrow(pca$x))

  ref <- rowMeans(scale(X), na.rm = TRUE)

  r <- apply(pca$x, 2, function(s) suppressWarnings(cor(s, ref, use = "complete.obs")))
  s <- ifelse(is.na(r) | r >= 0, 1, -1)

  pca$x        <- sweep(pca$x, 2, s, `*`)
  pca$rotation <- sweep(pca$rotation, 2, s, `*`)
  attr(pca, "sign_flipped") <- s < 0
  attr(pca, "ref_cor") <- abs(r)
  pca
}

pc <- prcomp(out_mat %>% t())

pc <- align_pc_sign(pc, out_mat %>% t())  


pc1 <- pc$rotation[,1]
pc2 <- pc$rotation[,2]
pc3 <- pc$rotation[,3]

clr_pca_data <- (out$key) %>%
  mutate(DASH = factor(ifelse(diet %in% c('DL','DH'), 1,0), labels=c("Comparison diet", "DASH4D diet")),
         sodium = factor(ifelse(diet %in% c('DL','CL'), 1,0), labels=c("high sodium", "low sodium")))

((pc$sdev)^2/sum((pc$sdev)^2))[1:3]

summary(lmer(pc1 ~ visit +DASH+ (1|subject), data=clr_pca_data))
summary(lmer(pc2 ~ visit +DASH+ (1|subject), data=clr_pca_data))
summary(lmer(pc3 ~ visit +DASH+ (1|subject), data=clr_pca_data))

summary(lmer(pc1 ~ visit +sodium+ (1|subject), data=clr_pca_data))
summary(lmer(pc2 ~ visit +sodium+ (1|subject), data=clr_pca_data))
summary(lmer(pc3 ~ visit +sodium+ (1|subject), data=clr_pca_data))


## clr pca data export
clr_pca_data_withpc <-
  merge(clr_pca_data,
        cbind(pc1,pc2),
        by=0) %>%
  rename(PC1 = pc1, PC2=pc2) %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, visit, DASH, sodium, diet, PC1, PC2) %>%
  melt(id.vars = c("subject", "visit", "DASH", "sodium", "diet")) %>%
  rename(PC = variable, pptid=subject)


write.table(clr_pca_data_withpc, 
          "../intermediate/microbiome/CLR_changefrombaseline_PCA_long.tsv",
          sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F)
```

### Diet's effect on a priori hypothesized microbes

#### Load and clean data
```{r microbe of interest a prior - butyrate producer, include=TRUE}

## read butyrate producer abundance
BUTYRATE_PRODUCER_RL = "../data/butyrate_prod_rl_ana_data.tsv"

butyrate_producer_with_diet <- read.table(BUTYRATE_PRODUCER_RL, header=T, sep="\t") %>%
  mutate(diet = factor(diet, levels=c("baseline", "CH","CL","DH","DL")),
         visit = factor(visit, levels=c("PRI", "FP1", "FP2", "FP3", "FP4")))


## subset baseline butyrate producer data
butyrate_producer_with_diet_baseline <- butyrate_producer_with_diet %>% 
  filter(diet == "baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(c(pptid,butyrate_producer,Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii)) %>%
  melt(id.vars=c("pptid")) %>% rename("baseline" = "value") 

## end-of-diet-period butyrate producer data with baseline
### transform to long
butyrate_producer_with_diet_withbaseline <- butyrate_producer_with_diet %>% 
  filter(pptid %in% butyrate_producer_with_diet_baseline$pptid) %>% filter(diet != "baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(c(pptid,visit,diet,batch,butyrate_producer,Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii)) %>%
  melt(id.vars=c("pptid","visit","diet","batch"))

## merge baseline with end-of-diet-period data
## calculate change from baseline (log ratio)
butyrate_producer_with_diet_changebaseline <- 
  merge(butyrate_producer_with_diet_withbaseline,
        butyrate_producer_with_diet_baseline,
        by=c("pptid","variable"), all.x=T) %>%
  mutate(changefrombaseline = log(value/baseline)) %>%
  dcast(pptid+visit+diet+batch ~ variable, value.var=c("changefrombaseline"))

```

#### Microbes of interest: butyrate producer 
```{r DASH - microbe modeling (from baseline) final - butyrate producer, include=T}


## carry-over data for butyrate producer
butyrate_producer_with_diet_changebaseline_carryover <- 
  butyrate_producer_with_diet_changebaseline %>%
  arrange(pptid, visit) %>% group_by(pptid) %>%
  mutate(lagdiet = lag(diet)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(lagCH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CH",1,0),
         lagCL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CL",1,0),
         lagDH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DH",1,0),
         lagDL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DL",1,0))


## change from baseline butyrate producer model
### lmer model with diet and period as fixed effect
butyrate_producer_changebaseline_final_visit <- 
  lmer(data=butyrate_producer_with_diet_changebaseline_carryover,
       butyrate_producer ~ diet  +(1|pptid) + visit,
       REML=TRUE)

### get emmeans object to average period effect
butyrate_producer_changebaseline_marginalmeans_DASH <- 
  emmeans(butyrate_producer_changebaseline_final_visit, 
          ~ diet)

### calculate estimates for contrasts
butyrate_producer_frombaseline_mean_sum <- summary(contrast(butyrate_producer_changebaseline_marginalmeans_DASH,
                                           method=list("DASH4D diet vs baseline" = c(0,0,0.5,0.5),
                "DASH4D diet vs baseline among low sodium" = c(0,0,0,1),
                "DASH4D diet vs baseline among high sodium" = c(0,0,1,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline" = c(0.5,0.5,0,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline among low sodium" = c(0,1,0,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline among high sodium" = c(1,0,0,0),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet" = c(-0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among low sodium" = c(0,-1,0,1),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among high sodium" = c(-1,0,1,0),
                "Difference in DASH4D effect in low sodium vs high sodium" = c(1,-1,-1,1),
                "low sodium vs baseline" = c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5),
                "high sodium vs baseline" = c(0.5,0,0.5,0),
                "low sodium vs high sodium" = c(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5)
                                                       )
                                           )
                                           ) %>%
                            mutate(lb = exp(estimate - qt(0.975, df=df)*SE),
                                   ub = exp(estimate + qt(0.975, df=df)*SE),
                                   estimate = exp(estimate)
                                   )


```

```{r ANCOMBC species DASH, include=TRUE}
                             exp(`lfc_DASH_baselineComparison diet` + 1.96*`se_DASH_baselineComparison diet`)),
         p = ifelse(`p_DASHDASH diet` == 1, "9.999e-01", sprintf("%.3e", `p_DASHDASH diet`)),
         q = ifelse(`q_DASHDASH diet` == 1, "9.999e-01", sprintf("%.3e", `q_DASHDASH diet`)),
         BH = ifelse(`BH` == 1, "9.999e-01", sprintf("%.3e", BH))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Tax, dashvcomp, p, q, BH, dashvbaseline, comparisonvbaseline)
```

### Subgroup analysis of primary microbiome outcomes
#### Prepare subgroup data
```{r microbiome-subgroup-preparation, include=TRUE}
# Subgroups in the original microbiome subgroup notebook.
mb_subgroup_variables <- c(
  "sex", "age_gp", "diabmeds_gp", "cholmeds_gp", "htnmeds_gp",
  "metformin", "glp1", "sglt2"
)

mb_add_subgroup_covariates <- function(data, age_variable) {
  needed <- c("sex", age_variable, "diabmeds_num", "cholmeds_num",
              "htnmeds_num", "metformin", "glp1ra", "sglt2i")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(data))
  if (length(missing)) {
    stop("Subgroup covariates absent from input: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  data %>%
    mutate(
      sex = factor(sex, labels = c("male", "female")),
      age_gp = factor(ifelse(.data[[age_variable]] < 65, 0, 1),
                      levels = 0:1, labels = c("<65 years", "65+ years")),
      diabmeds_gp = factor(case_when(diabmeds_num == 0 ~ 0,
                                     diabmeds_num == 1 ~ 1,
                                     diabmeds_num > 1 ~ 2),
                           levels = 0:2, labels = c("0", "1", "2+")),
      cholmeds_gp = factor(case_when(cholmeds_num == 0 ~ 0,
                                     cholmeds_num == 1 ~ 1,
                                     cholmeds_num > 1 ~ 2),
                           levels = 0:2, labels = c("0", "1", "2+")),
      htnmeds_gp = factor(case_when(htnmeds_num <= 1 ~ 0,
                                    htnmeds_num == 2 ~ 1,
                                    htnmeds_num > 2 ~ 2),
                          levels = 0:2, labels = c("0-1", "2", "3+")),
      glp1 = factor(glp1ra, labels = c("no", "yes")),
      sglt2 = factor(sglt2i, labels = c("no", "yes")),
      metformin = factor(metformin, labels = c("no", "yes"))
    )
}

# Guard against accidental many-to-many joins, which would duplicate
# observations and change their weights in the mixed-effects models.
mb_require_unique <- function(data, keys, description) {
  if (anyDuplicated(data[keys])) {
    stop("Nonunique ", description, " keys: ", paste(keys, collapse = ", "))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

mb_alpha_covariates <- mb_add_subgroup_covariates(
  alpha_diversity_diet_DASH, "age_rz") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, pptid, visit, diet,
                all_of(mb_subgroup_variables))
mb_require_unique(mb_alpha_covariates,
                  c("pptid", "visit", "diet"), "alpha-diversity")

# Change-from-baseline metrics have already been calculated in the primary
# analysis; only append the subgroup covariates.
mb_alpha_subgroup_data <- alpha_diversity_diet_changebaseline_DASH %>%
  left_join(mb_alpha_covariates %>% dplyr::select(-sample_id),
            by = c("pptid", "visit", "diet"))

mb_butyrate_covariates <- mb_add_subgroup_covariates(
  butyrate_producer_with_diet, "age_rz") %>%
  dplyr::select(pptid, visit, diet, all_of(mb_subgroup_variables))
mb_require_unique(mb_butyrate_covariates,
                  c("pptid", "visit", "diet"), "butyrate-producer")

# The primary abundance analysis already calculated log(value / baseline)
# for butyrate producers and F. prausnitzii.
mb_butyrate_subgroup_data <- butyrate_producer_with_diet_changebaseline %>%
  left_join(mb_butyrate_covariates,
            by = c("pptid", "visit", "diet"))

# The source subgroup notebook uses this fixed species list for the DASH
# index. Do not replace it with the separate, DA-derived index later in the
# main notebook without first confirming that their feature sets match.
mb_dash_index_up_taxa <- DASH_all_DA_result_export %>% 
                              filter(`lfc_DASHDASH diet` > 0 & `q_DASHDASH diet` < 0.05) %>% 
                              pull(taxon)
mb_dash_index_down_taxa <- DASH_all_DA_result_export %>% 
                              filter(`lfc_DASHDASH diet` < 0 & `p_DASHDASH diet` < 0.05) %>% 
                              pull(taxon)
mb_missing_taxa <- setdiff(c(mb_dash_index_up_taxa, mb_dash_index_down_taxa),
                           names(species_filtered_clean_included))
if (length(mb_missing_taxa)) {
  stop("Species needed for subgroup DASH index are missing: ",
       paste(mb_missing_taxa, collapse = ", "))
}

mb_index_by_sample <- tibble(
  sample_id = rownames(species_filtered_clean_included),
  dash_up = log2(rowSums(species_filtered_clean_included[
    , mb_dash_index_up_taxa, drop = FALSE])),
  dash_down = log2(rowSums(species_filtered_clean_included[
    , mb_dash_index_down_taxa, drop = FALSE]))
) %>%
  mutate(dash_index = dash_up - dash_down)

mb_index_withmeta <- mb_index_by_sample %>%
  inner_join(mb_alpha_covariates, by = "sample_id")
mb_index_baseline <- mb_index_withmeta %>%
  filter(diet == "baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(pptid, dash_up, dash_down, dash_index) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_baseline"), -pptid)
mb_require_unique(mb_index_baseline, "pptid", "DASH index baseline")

mb_index_subgroup_data <- mb_index_withmeta %>%
  filter(diet != "baseline") %>%
  inner_join(mb_index_baseline, by = "pptid") %>%
  transmute(
    pptid, visit, diet, across(all_of(mb_subgroup_variables)),
    dash_up = dash_up - dash_up_baseline,
    dash_down = dash_down - dash_down_baseline,
    dash_index = dash_index - dash_index_baseline
  )
```

#### Functions and constants for subgroup analysis
```{r microbiome-subgroup-functions, include=TRUE}
# All contrasts assume four non-baseline diet levels in this order.
mb_diet_levels <- c("CH", "CL", "DH", "DL")
mb_diet_effect <- c(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
mb_sodium_effect <- c(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5)

# Labels match the covariate coding above (including HTN medication groups).
mb_subgroup_labels <- list(
  sex = list(strata = c("males", "females"), difference = "male vs female"),
  age_gp = list(strata = c("<65 years", "65+ years"),
                difference = "<65 vs 65+"),
  diabmeds_gp = list(strata = c("0", "1", "2+")),
  cholmeds_gp = list(strata = c("0", "1", "2+")),
  htnmeds_gp = list(strata = c("0-1", "2", "3+")),
  metformin = list(strata = c("non-metformin user", "metformin user"),
                   difference = "non-metformin user vs metformin user"),
  glp1 = list(strata = c("non-glp1 user", "glp1 user"),
              difference = "non-glp1 user vs glp1 user"),
  sglt2 = list(strata = c("non-sglt2 user", "sglt2 user"),
               difference = "non-sglt2 user vs sglt2 user")
)

mb_in_subgroup <- function(weights, group_index, n_groups) {
  output <- numeric(length(weights) * n_groups)
  positions <- (group_index - 1) * length(weights) + seq_along(weights)
  output[positions] <- weights
  output
}

mb_make_subgroup_contrasts <- function(subgroup, include_sodium = TRUE) {
  info <- mb_subgroup_labels[[subgroup]]
  if (is.null(info)) stop("Unknown subgroup: ", subgroup)
  n_groups <- length(info$strata)

  dash <- lapply(seq_len(n_groups), function(i) {
    mb_in_subgroup(mb_diet_effect, i, n_groups)
  })
  names(dash) <- paste0("DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among ", info$strata)

  if (n_groups == 2) {
    delta <- list(dash[[1]] - dash[[2]])
    names(delta) <- paste("DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet", info$difference)
    dash <- c(dash, delta)
  }
  if (!include_sodium) return(dash)

  sodium <- lapply(seq_len(n_groups), function(i) {
    mb_in_subgroup(mb_sodium_effect, i, n_groups)
  })
  names(sodium) <- paste0("low sodium vs high sodium among ", info$strata)

  if (n_groups == 2) {
    delta <- list(sodium[[1]] - sodium[[2]])
    names(delta) <- paste("low sodium vs high sodium", info$difference)
    sodium <- c(sodium, delta)
  }
  c(dash, sodium)
}

# For three-level subgroup variables, the original analysis jointly tested
# heterogeneity in the diet effect (and, when applicable, sodium effect).
mb_run_joint_test <- function(model, subgroup, weights, label) {
  by_group <- emmeans(model,
                      specs = as.formula(paste("~ diet |", subgroup)),
                      lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
  test(pairs(contrast(by_group,
                      method = setNames(list(weights), label),
                      adjust = "none"),
             by = NULL),
       joint = TRUE)
}

mb_run_subgroup_model <- function(data, outcome, subgroup,
                                  include_sodium = TRUE,
                                  exponentiate = FALSE,
                                  digits = 2) {
  if (!subgroup %in% names(data) || !outcome %in% names(data)) {
    stop("Missing outcome or subgroup: ", outcome, " / ", subgroup)
  }

  # Same mixed-effects specification and REML approach as the original.
  formula <- as.formula(paste0(
    outcome, " ~ diet * ", subgroup, " + (1 | pptid) + visit"))
  model <- lmer(formula, data = data, REML = TRUE)
  means <- emmeans(model,
                   specs = as.formula(paste0("~ diet * ", subgroup)),
                   lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

  # Check the marginal-means grid before applying four-diet-cell weights.
  grid <- as.data.frame(means)
  group_levels <- levels(data[[subgroup]])
  n_groups <- length(mb_subgroup_labels[[subgroup]]$strata)
  if (length(group_levels) != n_groups ||
      nrow(grid) != 4 * n_groups ||
      !identical(as.character(grid$diet), rep(mb_diet_levels, n_groups)) ||
      !identical(as.character(grid[[subgroup]]), rep(group_levels, each = 4))) {
    stop("Unexpected emmeans grid/order for ", outcome, " / ", subgroup,
         "; verify factor levels before applying contrast weights.")
  }

  contrasts <- summary(contrast(
    means, method = mb_make_subgroup_contrasts(subgroup, include_sodium))) %>%
    mutate(lb = estimate - qt(0.975, df = df) * SE,
           ub = estimate + qt(0.975, df = df) * SE)

  if (exponentiate) {
    # Butyrate/F. prausnitzii models use log ratios from baseline.
    contrasts <- contrasts %>%
      mutate(estimate = exp(estimate), lb = exp(lb), ub = exp(ub))
  }

  # Preserve source output: two-level interaction rows show p-values,
  # within-stratum estimates show estimates (95% CIs).
  contrasts <- contrasts %>%
    mutate(print = ifelse(
      n_groups == 2 & row_number() %in% c(3, if (include_sodium) 6 else 3),
      sprintf("%.3f", p.value),
      sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f)"),
              estimate, lb, ub)))

  global_tests <- NULL
  if (n_groups == 3) {
    global_tests <- list(
      DASH = mb_run_joint_test(model, subgroup, mb_diet_effect,
                               "DASH4D vs Comparison"))
    if (include_sodium) {
      global_tests$sodium <- mb_run_joint_test(
        model, subgroup, mb_sodium_effect, "low sodium vs high sodium")
    }
  }

  list(model = model, marginal_means = means,
       contrasts = contrasts, global_tests = global_tests)
}

mb_run_subgroup_panel <- function(data, outcomes, digits,
                                  include_sodium, exponentiate) {
  groups <- names(mb_subgroup_labels)
  setNames(lapply(groups, function(group) {
    setNames(lapply(seq_along(outcomes), function(i) {
      mb_run_subgroup_model(data, outcomes[[i]], group,
                            include_sodium = include_sodium,
                            exponentiate = exponentiate,
                            digits = digits[[i]])
    }), outcomes)
  }), groups)
}
```

#### Publication-style subgroup result tables
The following tables show the marginal diet effect, the number of unique participants
included in each model, subgroup-specific estimates (95% CI), and a p-value for
interaction. For two-level subgroups, the interaction p-value is taken from the
between-stratum contrast; for three-level subgroups, it is the joint test already
computed in the subgroup analysis. The marginal estimate comes from the
corresponding model without subgroup interactions, using the same outcome data.

```{r microbiome-subgroup-table-functions, include=TRUE}
# Shared formatting helpers are also used by the SCFA subgroup tables below.
sgtbl_titles <- c(
  shannon = "Shannon diversity",
  observed_otus = "Observed species richness",
  pielou_e = "Pielou's evenness",
  butyrate_producer = "Butyrate-producer abundance",
  Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii = "F. prausnitzii abundance",
  dash_index = "DASH4D microbiome index"
)
sgtbl_group_titles <- c(
  sex = "Gender", age_gp = "Age", diabmeds_gp = "Diabetes medications",
  cholmeds_gp = "Cholesterol medications",
  htnmeds_gp = "Hypertension medications", metformin = "Metformin",
  glp1 = "GLP-1 receptor agonists", sglt2 = "SGLT2 inhibitors"
)

sgtbl_outcome_title <- function(outcome) {
  if (outcome %in% names(sgtbl_titles)) return(unname(sgtbl_titles[[outcome]]))
  base <- gsub("_(fecal|plasma)$", "", outcome)
  paste0(stringr::str_to_title(base),
         if (grepl("_fecal$", outcome)) " (fecal)" else " (plasma)")
}
sgtbl_level_title <- function(level) {
  labels <- c(male = "Male", female = "Female", no = "No", yes = "Yes")
  if (level %in% names(labels)) unname(labels[[level]]) else level
}
sgtbl_p <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) != 1 || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x)) return("NA")
  if (x < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", x)
}
sgtbl_ci <- function(est, lower, upper, digits) {
  if (any(!is.finite(c(est, lower, upper)))) return("NA")
  fmt <- paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f)")
  sprintf(fmt, est, lower, upper)
}
sgtbl_n <- function(model, subgroup = NULL, level = NULL) {
  used <- as.data.frame(stats::model.frame(model))
  if (!is.null(subgroup)) {
    used <- used[!is.na(used[[subgroup]]) &
                   as.character(used[[subgroup]]) == level, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  length(unique(used$pptid[!is.na(used$pptid)]))
}

# Refit only the marginal (non-interaction) model to get the overall estimate
# for the same outcome and analytic dataset; subgroup fits are NOT changed.
sgtbl_marginal <- function(data, outcome, diet_var,
                           digits, exponentiate = FALSE,
                           log_response = FALSE) {
  response <- if (log_response) paste0("log(", outcome, ")") else outcome
  formula <- as.formula(paste0(response, " ~ ", diet_var,
                                " + visit + (1 | pptid)"))
  fit <- lmer(formula, data = data, REML = TRUE)
  em <- emmeans(fit, specs = as.formula(paste("~", diet_var)),
                lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
  if (!identical(as.character(as.data.frame(em)[[diet_var]]), mb_diet_levels)) {
    stop("Unexpected marginal diet levels for ", outcome)
  }
  comparisons <- summary(contrast(em, method = list(
    DASH = mb_diet_effect, sodium = mb_sodium_effect)))
  comparisons$lb <- comparisons$estimate - qt(0.975, comparisons$df) * comparisons$SE
  comparisons$ub <- comparisons$estimate + qt(0.975, comparisons$df) * comparisons$SE
  if (exponentiate) {
    comparisons$estimate <- exp(comparisons$estimate)
    comparisons$lb <- exp(comparisons$lb)
    comparisons$ub <- exp(comparisons$ub)
  }
  values <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(comparisons)), function(i) {
    sgtbl_ci(comparisons$estimate[i], comparisons$lb[i], comparisons$ub[i], digits)
  }), as.character(comparisons$contrast))
  list(n = sgtbl_n(fit), values = values, model = fit)
}

# Get the existing stratum contrasts and interaction tests directly from
# the saved subgroup model results, rather than recomputing them.
sgtbl_subgroup_effect <- function(result, subgroup, comparison, digits) {
  used <- as.data.frame(stats::model.frame(result$model))
  levels_used <- levels(used[[subgroup]])
  k <- length(levels_used)
  if (!k %in% c(2L, 3L)) stop("Expected 2 or 3 levels for ", subgroup)
  offset <- if (comparison == "DASH") 0L else k + as.integer(k == 2L)
  ids <- offset + seq_len(k)
  cs <- as.data.frame(result$contrasts)
  if (nrow(cs) < max(ids)) stop("Missing subgroup contrasts: ", subgroup)
  formatted <- vapply(ids, function(i) {
    sgtbl_ci(cs$estimate[i], cs$lb[i], cs$ub[i], digits)
  }, character(1))
  n <- vapply(levels_used, function(level) {
    sgtbl_n(result$model, subgroup, level)
  }, integer(1))
  if (k == 2L) {
    p <- cs$p.value[offset + k + 1L]
  } else {
    joint <- result$global_tests[[comparison]]
    if (is.null(joint) || !"p.value" %in% names(as.data.frame(joint))) {
      stop("Missing joint interaction test: ", subgroup, "/", comparison)
    }
    p <- as.data.frame(joint)$p.value[1]
  }
  list(levels = levels_used, n = n, effects = formatted, p = p)
}

sgtbl_make_table <- function(panel, outcome, comparison,
                             digits, marginal) {
  rows <- list(data.frame(Subgroups = "Marginal", N = as.character(marginal$n),
                          Result = marginal$values[[comparison]]))
  for (group in names(panel)) {
    r <- sgtbl_subgroup_effect(panel[[group]][[outcome]], group,
                               comparison, digits)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      Subgroups = unname(sgtbl_group_titles[[group]]), N = "", Result = "")
    for (j in seq_along(r$levels)) {
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        Subgroups = paste0("  ", sgtbl_level_title(r$levels[j])),
        N = as.character(r$n[j]), Result = r$effects[j])
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      Subgroups = "p-value for interaction", N = "",
      Result = sgtbl_p(r$p))
  }
  tab <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  names(tab)[3] <- sgtbl_outcome_title(outcome)
  tab
}

sgtbl_make_panel <- function(panel, data, outcomes, digits,
                             diet_var, exponentiate = FALSE,
                             log_response = FALSE,
                             include_sodium = TRUE) {
  result <- list(DASH = list(), sodium = list())
  for (i in seq_along(outcomes)) {
    outcome <- outcomes[[i]]
    marg <- sgtbl_marginal(data, outcome, diet_var, digits[[i]],
                           exponentiate, log_response)
    comparisons <- if (include_sodium) c("DASH", "sodium") else "DASH"
    for (comparison in comparisons) {
      result[[comparison]][[outcome]] <-
        sgtbl_make_table(panel, outcome, comparison, digits[[i]], marg)
    }
  }
  result
}

# Extract a stand-alone table for one subgroup and one outcome, matching
# the example layout (Marginal, subgroup header, levels, interaction p-value).
sgtbl_one_subgroup <- function(tab, subgroup) {
  start <- which(tab$Subgroups == unname(sgtbl_group_titles[[subgroup]]))
  if (length(start) != 1L) stop("Subgroup not found in table: ", subgroup)
  ends <- which(tab$Subgroups == "p-value for interaction" &
                  seq_len(nrow(tab)) > start)
  if (!length(ends)) stop("Interaction p-value row missing: ", subgroup)
  rbind(tab[1, , drop = FALSE], tab[seq.int(start, ends[1]), , drop = FALSE])
}

sgtbl_save <- function(tables, path) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (comparison in names(tables)) for (outcome in names(tables[[comparison]])) {
    safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", outcome)
    write.table(tables[[comparison]][[outcome]],
                file.path(path, paste0(comparison, "_", safe_name, ".tsv")),
                sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
  invisible(tables)
}

sgtbl_print <- function(tables) {
  for (comparison in names(tables)) {
    if (!length(tables[[comparison]])) next
    title <- if (comparison == "DASH") "DASH4D vs Comparison diet" else
      "Low vs high sodium"
    cat(paste0("##### ", title, "\n\n"))
    for (outcome in names(tables[[comparison]])) {
      cat(paste0("**", sgtbl_outcome_title(outcome), "**\n\n"))
      tab <- tables[[comparison]][[outcome]]
      k <- knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", align = c("l", "r", "l"))
      k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, bootstrap_options = "condensed",
                                    full_width = FALSE)
      section_rows <- which(tab$Subgroups %in%
                            c("Marginal", unname(sgtbl_group_titles)))
      k <- kableExtra::row_spec(k, section_rows, bold = TRUE)
      cat(as.character(k), "\n\n")
    }
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r microbiome-subgroup-compile-tables, include=TRUE}

  mb_alpha_results, mb_alpha_subgroup_data,
  c("shannon", "observed_otus", "pielou_e"), c(2, 0, 3),
  diet_var = "diet")
mb_tables_abund <- sgtbl_make_panel(
  mb_abundance_results, mb_butyrate_subgroup_data,
  c("butyrate_producer", "Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii"), c(2, 2),
  diet_var = "diet", exponentiate = TRUE, include_sodium = FALSE)
mb_tables_index <- sgtbl_make_panel(
  mb_index_results, mb_index_subgroup_data, "dash_index", 2,
  diet_var = "diet")

mb_subgroup_tables <- list(
  DASH = c(mb_tables_alpha$DASH, mb_tables_abund$DASH,
           mb_tables_index$DASH),
  sodium = c(mb_tables_alpha$sodium, mb_tables_index$sodium)
)
sgtbl_save(mb_subgroup_tables,
           "../intermediate/microbiome/subgroup_tables")

```

```{r microbiome-subgroup-show-tables, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
sgtbl_print(mb_subgroup_tables)
```

*Note:* N is the number of unique participants contributing to each fitted model.
Estimates are differences (95% CI) for alpha diversity and the DASH4D microbiome
index; microbial abundance estimates are exponentiated ratios (95% CI).
The interaction p-values are from the original subgroup model results (a
between-stratum contrast for two-level groups or a joint heterogeneity test
for three-level groups). The marginal models do not include subgroup interactions.


## Microbiome functions

### Butyrate synthesis gene analyses

#### Load and clean data
##### butyrate synthesis pathway: minimum counts of genes on the pathway
```{r load butyrate synthesis}


BUTYRATE_GENE <- "../data/butyrate_gene_withmeta_humanGI.tsv"

butyrate_gene_with_diet <- read.table(BUTYRATE_GENE, header=T, sep="\t") %>%
  mutate(diet = factor(diet, levels=c("baseline", "CH","CL","DH","DL")),
         visit = factor(visit, levels=c("PRI", "FP1", "FP2", "FP3", "FP4")),
         log_depth = log(nonhost/1000000),
         total_butyrate_gene_p = total/nonhost) %>%
  group_by(pptid) %>% mutate(pptid_num = cur_group_id()) %>% ungroup() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(acetyl_coa_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(Thl, Hbd, Cro)), 0, min(Thl, Hbd, Cro)),
         glutarate_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(HgCoAd_A, HgCoAd_B, HgCoAd_C,
                            HgdA, HgdB, GctA, GctB)), 0, 
                        min(HgCoAd_A, HgCoAd_B, HgCoAd_C,
                            HgdA, HgdB, GctA, GctB)),
         lysine_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(KamA, KamD, KamE, Kce, Kdd, Kal)), 0, 
                        min(KamA, KamD, KamE, Kce, Kdd, Kal)),
         fouramino_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(AbfD.Isom, AbfH)), 0, min(AbfD.Isom, AbfH))
         ) 


```

```{r butyrate-butyrate-gene-sodium-effect, include=T}

term_gene_sodium_effect <- data.frame(gene = term_gene_list) %>%

  term_gene_sodium_effect[i,"highvbaselineub"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[3,8])

}


term_gene_sodium_effect$p.adj <- 
  p.adjust(term_gene_sodium_effect$pval,
           method="holm")


but_path_list <- c("acetyl_coa_path",
                   "glutarate_path",
                   "lysine_path",
                   "fouramino_path")


but_path_sodium_effect <- data.frame(gene = but_path_list) %>%
  mutate(lowvhigh = NA,
         pval = NA)

  species = but_path_list[i]

    geeglm(data=butyrate_gene_with_diet,

                                df=Inf)

  contrast(temp_marginalmeans,
           method=list("low sodium vs high sodium" = c(0,-0.5,0.5,-0.5,0.5),
                       "low sodium vs baseline" = c(-1,0,0.5,0,0.5),
                       "high sodium vs baseline" = c(-1,0.5,0,0.5,0))
           )
  ) %>% mutate(lb = estimate - qnorm(0.975)*SE,
               ub = estimate + qnorm(0.975)*SE) 
  
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"lowvhigh"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[1,2])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"lowvhighlb"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[1,7])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"lowvhighub"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[1,8])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"pval"] = temp_mean_sum[1,6]
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"lowvbaseline"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[2,2])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"lowvbaselinelb"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[2,7])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"lowvbaselineub"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[2,8])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"highvbaseline"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[3,2])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"highvbaselinelb"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[3,7])
  but_path_sodium_effect[i,"highvbaselineub"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[3,8])
```

#### Butyrate-synthesis gene by species: but gene
```{r butyrate-but-gene-by-species, include=T}

BUTYRATE_GENE_RAW <- "../data/butyrate_gene_bysample_included_humanGI.tsv"

butyrate_gene_raw_long <- read.table(BUTYRATE_GENE_RAW, header=T, sep="\t")

but_gene_long <- butyrate_gene_raw_long %>% filter(geneID == 'But') 

but_gene_long_p_baseline <- but_gene_long  %>%
  filter(str_detect(specimen_label, "PRI")) %>%
  group_by(specimen_label, geneID) %>%
  mutate(p_contri = count/sum(count)) %>% ungroup()

write.table(but_gene_long_p_baseline,
            "../intermediate/microbiome/but_gene_contri_data.tsv",
            sep="\t", row.names=F, quote=F)

but_gene_baseline_contri_sum <- but_gene_long_p_baseline %>% group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(median = median(p_contri),
            q1=quantile(p_contri, 0.25),
            q3=quantile(p_contri, 0.75)) %>% ungroup()


butyrate_gene_meta <- butyrate_gene_with_diet %>% 
  dplyr::select(pptid, visit,diet, log_depth) %>% as.data.frame()


rownames(butyrate_gene_meta) <- paste(butyrate_gene_meta$pptid,
                                       butyrate_gene_meta$visit,
                                       "Micro.Fe1", sep=".")

but_gene_long_withchar <- merge(but_gene_long %>% filter(specimen_label %in% rownames(butyrate_gene_meta)),
                                butyrate_gene_meta %>% dplyr::select(pptid, diet, log_depth),
                                by.x="specimen_label", by.y=0, all.x=T)


but_gene_wide_withchar <- but_gene_long_withchar %>%
  dcast(pptid + diet + log_depth + specimen_label + geneID ~ taxon, value.var="count")

but_gene_wide_withchar <- but_gene_wide_withchar %>%
  as.matrix() %>% apply(2, function(x){ifelse(is.na(x),0,x)}) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(diet = factor(diet, levels=c("baseline", "CH","CL","DH","DL")),
         log_depth = as.numeric(log_depth)) %>%
  group_by(pptid) %>% mutate(pptid_num = cur_group_id()) %>% ungroup() 


but_species_list <- unique(but_gene_long_withchar$taxon)



but_gene_DASH_effect <- data.frame(gene = but_species_list) %>%
  mutate(DASHvComp = NA,
         pval = NA)



for (i in 1:length(but_species_list)){
  
  species = but_species_list[i]
  
  value = as.numeric(but_gene_wide_withchar[,species][[1]])
  

  temp_model <- 
    geeglm(data=but_gene_wide_withchar,
           value ~ diet + offset(log_depth),
           id=pptid_num,
           family=poisson(), corstr="ex")
  
  temp_marginalmeans <- emmeans(temp_model, ~ diet,
                                df=Inf)

  temp_mean_sum <- summary(
    contrast(temp_marginalmeans,
           method=list("DASH diet vs Comparison diet" = c(0,-0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5),
                       "DASH diet vs baseline" = c(-1,0,0,0.5,0.5),
                       "Comparison diet vs baseline" = c(-1,0.5,0.5,0,0))
           )
    ) %>% mutate(lb = estimate - qnorm(0.975)*SE,
               ub = estimate + qnorm(0.975)*SE) 
  
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"DASHvComp"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[1,2])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"lb"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[1,7])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"ub"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[1,8])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"pval"] = temp_mean_sum[1,6]
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"DASHvbaseline"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[2,2])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"DASHvbaselinelb"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[2,7])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"DASHvbaselineub"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[2,8])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"Comparisonvbaseline"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[3,2])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"Comparisonvbaselinelb"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[3,7])
  but_gene_DASH_effect[i,"Comparisonvbaselineub"] = exp(temp_mean_sum[3,8])

}


but_gene_DASH_effect$p_BH <- 
  p.adjust(but_gene_DASH_effect$pval,
           method="BH") 

but_gene_DASH_effect$p_holm <- 
  p.adjust(but_gene_DASH_effect$pval,
           method="holm")


but_gene_DASH_effect_print <-
  merge(but_gene_DASH_effect %>%
    mutate(dashvcomp = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                                   DASHvComp, lb, ub),
           dashvbaseline = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                                   DASHvbaseline,DASHvbaselinelb,DASHvbaselineub),
           compvbaseline = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                                   Comparisonvbaseline, Comparisonvbaselinelb, Comparisonvbaselineub),
           
           p = case_when(pval < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                         pval >= 0.001 & pval <1 ~ sprintf("%.3f", pval),
                         pval == 1 ~ "0.999"),
           p_holm = case_when(p_holm < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                         p_holm >= 0.001 & p_holm <1 ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_holm),
                         p_holm == 1 ~ "0.999"),
           p_BH = case_when(p_BH < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                         p_BH >= 0.001 & p_BH <1 ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_BH),
                         p_BH == 1 ~ "0.999")
           ) %>% dplyr::select(gene, dashvcomp, p, p_holm, p_BH, dashvbaseline, compvbaseline),
        but_gene_baseline_contri_sum %>% mutate(
          contri = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)",
                           median, q1, q3)
        ) %>% dplyr::select(taxon, contri),
        by.x='gene', by.y='taxon'
        ) %>% arrange(desc(contri))



but_gene_DASH_effect_all <-
  rbind(but_gene_DASH_effect,
        c(NA,
          as.numeric(term_gene_DASH_effect[term_gene_DASH_effect$gene == 'But',2:11]) ,
          rep(NA,2))) %>%
  mutate(DASHvComp_err = DASHvComp - lb,
         DASHvbaseline_err = DASHvbaseline - DASHvbaselinelb,
         Comparisonvbaseline_err = Comparisonvbaseline - Comparisonvbaselinelb)

but_gene_DASH_effect_all[is.na(but_gene_DASH_effect_all$gene),]$gene = 'total'

write.table(but_gene_DASH_effect_all,
            "../intermediate/microbiome/but_gene_DASH_effect.tsv",
            sep="\t", row.names=F, quote=F)

```

#### KEGG gene analysis: DASH4D vs comparison
```{r kegg-kegg-gene-dash, include=T}

KEGG_GENE <- "../data/kegg_gene_withmeta.tsv"

kegg_gene_with_diet <- read.table(KEGG_GENE, header=T, sep="\t") %>%

# 2. Function to fetch and parse data in chunks
fetch_kegg_details <- function(ko_list) {
  # Add 'ko:' prefix if missing
  ko_list <- paste0("ko:", gsub("ko:", "", ko_list))

  # Split into chunks of 10 (KEGG API max per request)
  chunks <- split(ko_list, ceiling(seq_along(ko_list) / 10))

  all_results <- list()

  message(paste("Starting download of", length(ko_list), "KOs in", length(chunks), "chunks..."))

  for (i in seq_along(chunks)) {
    message(paste("Processing chunk", i, "of", length(chunks)))

    # API Call
    query <- keggGet(chunks[[i]])

    # Parse each entry in the chunk
    chunk_data <- lapply(query, function(entry) {
      list(
        KO = entry$ENTRY,
        Gene_Name = ifelse(!is.null(entry$NAME), entry$NAME, NA),
        Annotation = ifelse(!is.null(entry$DEFINITION), entry$DEFINITION, NA),
        # Pathways are returned as a named vector; we collapse them into a string
        Pathways = ifelse(!is.null(entry$PATHWAY),
                          paste(names(entry$PATHWAY), entry$PATHWAY, sep = ": ", collapse = "; "),
                          NA)
      )
    })

    all_results <- c(all_results, chunk_data)

    # 3. Frequency Control: Pause for 1 second between chunks
    if (i < length(chunks)) Sys.sleep(1)
  }

  # Convert list to a clean data frame
  final_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_results, as.data.frame))
  return(final_df)
}

# 4. Execute the script
ko_info_table <- fetch_kegg_details(kegg_DASH_effect_DA_sig$taxon)
```

### Load data and clean: calculate DASH4D microbe index
```{r DASH4D microbe index, include=T}


butyrate_gene_with_diet <- read.table(BUTYRATE_GENE, header=T, sep="\t") %>%
  mutate(diet = factor(diet, levels=c("baseline", "CH","CL","DH","DL")),
         visit = factor(visit, levels=c("PRI", "FP1", "FP2", "FP3", "FP4")),
         log_depth = log(nonhost/1000000),
         total_butyrate_gene_p = total/nonhost) %>%
  group_by(pptid) %>% mutate(pptid_num = cur_group_id()) %>% ungroup() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(acetyl_coa_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(Thl, Hbd, Cro)), 0, min(Thl, Hbd, Cro)),
         glutarate_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(HgCoAd_A, HgCoAd_B, HgCoAd_C,
                            HgdA, HgdB, GctA, GctB)), 0, 
                        min(HgCoAd_A, HgCoAd_B, HgCoAd_C,
                            HgdA, HgdB, GctA, GctB)),
         lysine_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(KamA, KamD, KamE, Kce, Kdd, Kal)), 0, 
                        min(KamA, KamD, KamE, Kce, Kdd, Kal)),
         fouramino_path = 
           ifelse(is.na(min(AbfD.Isom, AbfH)), 0, min(AbfD.Isom, AbfH))
         ) %>%
  mutate(But_log = log(But/(nonhost/1000000),2),
         EtfA_log = log(EtfA/(nonhost/1000000),2),
         EtfB_log = log(EtfB/(nonhost/1000000),2),
         Acetyl_CoA_log = log(acetyl_coa_path/(nonhost/1000000),2))




species_DASH_index <-

                        rowSums(
                          across(

                              filter(`lfc_DASHDASH diet` > 0 & `q_DASHDASH diet` < 0.05) %>% 
                              pull(taxon)
                            )
                          ),
                        2
                        ),
         dash_down = log(
                        rowSums(
                          across(
                            DASH_all_DA_result_export %>% 
                              filter(`lfc_DASHDASH diet` < 0 & `p_DASHDASH diet` < 0.05) %>% 
                              pull(taxon)
                            )
                          ),
                        2
                        ),
         dash_index = dash_up - dash_down) %>%
  dplyr::select(dash_up, dash_down, dash_index)
```

```{r clinical association with microbes, include=T}
clinical_data_raw <- alpha_diversity_diet_DASH  %>%
  dplyr::select(c(pptid,visit,diet, SBP, DBP, fructosamine, insulin_num,  
                  fb_glucose, sglt2i, glp1ra, diabmeds_num,
                  htnmeds_num, cholmeds_num,
                  age_rz,
                  glp1ra, metformin, sex))  %>%
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, labels=c("male", "female")),
         age_gp = factor(ifelse(age_rz < 65, 0,1),
                         labels=c("<65 years", "65+ years")),
         diabmeds_gp = factor(case_when(diabmeds_num == 0 ~ 0,
                                        diabmeds_num == 1 ~ 1,
                                        diabmeds_num > 1 ~ 2),
                              labels=c("0", "1", "2+")),
         htnmeds_gp = factor(case_when(htnmeds_num <= 1 ~ 0,
                                        htnmeds_num == 2 ~ 1,
                                        htnmeds_num > 2 ~ 2),
                             labels=c("0-1", "2", "3+")),
        cholmeds_gp = factor(case_when(cholmeds_num == 0 ~ 0,
                                        cholmeds_num == 1 ~ 1,
                                        cholmeds_num > 1 ~ 2),
                             labels=c("0", "1", "2+")),
         glp1 = factor(glp1ra, labels=c("no", "yes")),
         sglt2 = factor(sglt2i, labels=c("no", "yes")),
         metformin = factor(metformin, labels=c("no", "yes")),
         log_insulin = log(insulin_num, 2)) %>%
  mutate(HOMA_IR = fb_glucose*insulin_num/405,
         log_HOMA_IR = log(HOMA_IR,2))
```

```{r baseline microbe gp, include=T}
                                   But_log > quantile(But_log, 2/3) ~3),
                                labels=c("T1","T2","T3")),
         EtfA_log_gp = factor(case_when(EtfA_log <= quantile(EtfA_log, 1/3) ~ 1,
                                   EtfA_log > quantile(EtfA_log, 1/3) &
                                   EtfA_log <= quantile(EtfA_log, 2/3) ~ 2,
                                   EtfA_log > quantile(EtfA_log, 2/3) ~3),
                                labels=c("T1","T2","T3")),
         EtfB_log_gp = factor(case_when(EtfB_log <= quantile(EtfB_log, 1/3) ~ 1,
                                   EtfB_log > quantile(EtfB_log, 1/3) &
                                   EtfB_log <= quantile(EtfB_log, 2/3) ~ 2,
                                   EtfB_log > quantile(EtfB_log, 2/3) ~3),
                                labels=c("T1","T2","T3")),
         Acetyl_CoA_log_gp = factor(case_when(Acetyl_CoA_log <= quantile(Acetyl_CoA_log, 1/3) ~ 1,
                                   Acetyl_CoA_log > quantile(Acetyl_CoA_log, 1/3) &
                                   Acetyl_CoA_log <= quantile(Acetyl_CoA_log, 2/3) ~ 2,
                                   Acetyl_CoA_log > quantile(Acetyl_CoA_log, 2/3) ~3),
                                labels=c("T1","T2","T3")))

clinical_changebaseline_withbaselinemicrobegp_nodiet <-
  merge(clinical_changebaseline,
        species_feature_baseline_gp %>% 
          dplyr::select(pptid, dash_index_gp,
                        shannon_gp,
                        butyrate_producer_gp,
                        f_praus_gp,
                        But_log_gp,
                        EtfA_log_gp,
                        EtfB_log_gp,
                        Acetyl_CoA_log_gp),
        by="pptid")


clinical_changebaseline_withbaselinemicrobegp <-
  merge(clinical_changebaseline_withbaselinemicrobegp_nodiet,
        baseline_diet %>% dplyr::select(participantid, dash_mellen, dash_fung),
        by.x='pptid', by.y='participantid', all.x=T) %>% 
  mutate(dash_mellen_gp = factor(case_when(dash_mellen <= quantile(dash_mellen, 1/3, na.rm=T) ~ 1,
                                   dash_mellen > quantile(dash_mellen, 1/3, na.rm=T) &
                                   dash_mellen <= quantile(dash_mellen, 2/3, na.rm=T) ~ 2,
                                   dash_mellen > quantile(dash_mellen, 2/3, na.rm=T) ~3),
                                labels=c("T1","T2","T3")),
          dash_fung_gp = factor(case_when(dash_fung <= quantile(dash_fung, 1/3, na.rm=T) ~ 1,
                                   dash_fung > quantile(dash_fung, 1/3, na.rm=T) &
                                   dash_fung <= quantile(dash_fung, 2/3, na.rm=T) ~ 2,
                                   dash_fung > quantile(dash_fung, 2/3, na.rm=T) ~3),
                                labels=c("T1","T2","T3"))
         ) %>%
  mutate(DASH = factor(ifelse(diet %in% c("CL", "CH"),
                              0,1),
                       labels=c("Comparison", "DASH4D")))
  


```

#### Publication-style tables: microbiome–clinical outcome associations
The following tables summarize the existing subgroup analyses of the association
between changes in microbiome features and changes in clinical outcomes. Each table
shows the overall (marginal) association, the estimates (95% CI) within the
subgroups, and the interaction p-values returned by the original analysis helper.
The models above are not changed or re-estimated here.

```{r clinical-subgroup-table-functions, include=TRUE}
# Use the data frames already produced by summarize_feature_associations()
# and run_subgroup_associations(). No additional input files or model fits.
clinical_sg_outcome_labels <- c(
  fb_glucose = "Fasting glucose",
  SBP = "Systolic blood pressure",
  DBP = "Diastolic blood pressure",
  fructosamine = "Fructosamine",
  log_HOMA_IR = "Log2 HOMA-IR"
)
clinical_sg_features <- c(
  dash_index_scale = "DASH4D microbiome index",
  shannon_scale = "Shannon diversity",
  butyrate_producer_scale = "Butyrate-producer abundance",
  Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii_scale = "F. prausnitzii abundance",
  But_log_scale = "But gene",
  EtfA_log_scale = "EtfA gene",
  EtfB_log_scale = "EtfB gene",
  Acetyl_CoA_log_scale = "Acetyl-CoA pathway"
)
# Original result-object names follow these conventions. The explicit mapping
# avoids accidentally using different variables from the global environment.
clinical_sg_outcome_suffix <- c(fb_glucose = "fg", SBP = "SBP", DBP = "DBP",
                                fructosamine = "fructosamine",
                                log_HOMA_IR = "log_HOMA_IR")
clinical_sg_feature_suffix <- c(
  dash_index_scale = "dashindex", shannon_scale = "shannon_scale",
  butyrate_producer_scale = "butyrateproducer",
  Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii_scale = "fpraus",
  But_log_scale = "butgene", EtfA_log_scale = "etfA",
  EtfB_log_scale = "EtfB", Acetyl_CoA_log_scale = "Acetyl_CoA"
)

clinical_sg_column <- function(data, candidates, required = TRUE) {
  # Prefer exact field names; accept common alternative names from helpers.
  match <- match(tolower(candidates), tolower(names(data)))
  match <- match[!is.na(match)]
  if (length(match)) return(names(data)[match[1]])
  if (required) {
    stop("Expected one of: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", "),
         "; available fields: ", paste(names(data), collapse = ", "))
  }
  NULL
}

clinical_sg_normalize <- function(x) {
  tolower(gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "", as.character(x)))
}

clinical_sg_raw_fields <- function(data, allow_missing_groups = FALSE) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  if (!nrow(data)) stop("The subgroup results data frame has no rows.")
  fields <- list(
    subgroup = clinical_sg_column(data,
      c("Variable", "Subgroup", "Subgroups", "Subgroup_variable", "stratum"),
      required = !allow_missing_groups),
    level = clinical_sg_column(data,
      c("Group", "Level", "Category", "Subgroup_level", "stratum_level"),
      required = !allow_missing_groups),
    n = clinical_sg_column(data, c("N", "n", "sample_size"), required = FALSE),
    estimate = clinical_sg_column(data,
      c("Est", "estimate", "beta", "effect", "coefficient")),
    lower = clinical_sg_column(data,
      c("lb", "lower.CL", "lower", "CI_lower", "lower_CI", "lcl")),
    upper = clinical_sg_column(data,
      c("ub", "upper.CL", "upper", "CI_upper", "upper_CI", "ucl")),
    interaction = clinical_sg_column(data,
      c("p_interaction", "p.interaction", "interaction_p", "p", "p.value"),
      required = FALSE)
  )
  list(data = data, fields = fields)
}

clinical_sg_feature_aliases <- list(
  dash_index_scale = c("dash_index_scale", "dash_index", "DASH4D microbiome index", "DASH4D index"),
  shannon_scale = c("shannon_scale", "shannon", "Shannon diversity"),
  butyrate_producer_scale = c("butyrate_producer_scale", "butyrate_producer", "butyrate producer"),
  Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii_scale = c("Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii_scale",
                                  "Faecalibacterium.prausnitzii", "F. prausnitzii", "fpraus"),
  But_log_scale = c("But_log_scale", "But_log", "But gene"),
  EtfA_log_scale = c("EtfA_log_scale", "EtfA_log", "EtfA gene"),
  EtfB_log_scale = c("EtfB_log_scale", "EtfB_log", "EtfB gene"),
  Acetyl_CoA_log_scale = c("Acetyl_CoA_log_scale", "Acetyl_CoA_log", "Acetyl-CoA gene", "Acetyl-CoA pathway")
)

clinical_sg_marginal_row <- function(marginal, predictor, digits = 2) {
  info <- clinical_sg_raw_fields(marginal, allow_missing_groups = TRUE)
  df <- info$data
  f <- info$fields
  id <- clinical_sg_column(df,
    c("Variable", "Feature", "Microbe", "Predictor", "Microbiome_feature"),
    required = FALSE)
  if (is.null(id)) {
    warning("Cannot identify microbiome feature column in marginal results for ",
            predictor, "; the marginal cell will be NA.")
    return(data.frame(Subgroups = "Marginal", N = "", Result = "NA"))
  }
  aliases <- clinical_sg_normalize(clinical_sg_feature_aliases[[predictor]])
  matches <- which(clinical_sg_normalize(df[[id]]) %in% aliases)
  if (length(matches) != 1L) {
    warning("Could not uniquely match ", predictor,
            " in marginal results; marginal cell will be NA.")
    return(data.frame(Subgroups = "Marginal", N = "", Result = "NA"))
  }
  i <- matches[1]
  n <- if (is.null(f$n)) "" else as.character(df[[f$n]][i])
  data.frame(Subgroups = "Marginal", N = n,
             Result = sgtbl_ci(as.numeric(df[[f$estimate]][i]),
                               as.numeric(df[[f$lower]][i]),
                               as.numeric(df[[f$upper]][i]), digits))
}

clinical_sg_display_subgroup <- function(x) {
  keys <- c(
    sex = "Gender", gender = "Gender", age_gp = "Age", age = "Age",
    diabmeds_gp = "Diabetes medications", diabmeds = "Diabetes medications",
    cholmeds_gp = "Cholesterol medications", cholmeds = "Cholesterol medications",
    htnmeds_gp = "Hypertension medications", htnmeds = "Hypertension medications",
    metformin = "Metformin", glp1 = "GLP-1 receptor agonists",
    sglt2 = "SGLT2 inhibitors"
  )
  match <- which(clinical_sg_normalize(names(keys)) == clinical_sg_normalize(x))
  if (length(match)) unname(keys[match[1]]) else as.character(x)
}

# The helper run_subgroup_associations() includes an overall/marginal row
# (Variable == "marginal", Group == NA). This is not a stratum. Reuse that
# estimate directly where possible, rather than interpreting it as a subgroup.
clinical_sg_table <- function(subgroup_result, marginal_result,
                              predictor, digits = 2) {
  info <- clinical_sg_raw_fields(subgroup_result)
  df <- info$data
  f <- info$fields
  group_ids <- as.character(df[[f$subgroup]])
  group_key <- clinical_sg_normalize(group_ids)
  is_marginal <- !is.na(group_ids) & group_key %in% c("marginal", "overall")

  # Prefer the marginal row produced in the *same subgroup analysis*, so that
  # its model specification and sample size match the subgroup results.
  marginal_row <- NULL
  marginal_indices <- which(is_marginal)
  if (length(marginal_indices)) {
    candidate_rows <- lapply(marginal_indices, function(i) {
      value <- sgtbl_ci(
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(df[[f$estimate]][i]))),
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(df[[f$lower]][i]))),
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(df[[f$upper]][i]))), digits)
      n <- if (is.null(f$n)) "" else as.character(df[[f$n]][i])
      if (is.na(n)) n <- ""
      data.frame(Subgroups = "Marginal", N = n, Result = value)
    })
    candidate_values <- vapply(candidate_rows, function(x)
      paste(x$N, x$Result, sep = "|"), character(1))
    if (length(unique(candidate_values)) == 1L &&
        candidate_rows[[1]]$Result != "NA") {
      marginal_row <- candidate_rows[[1]]
    } else {
      warning("Non-unique or missing marginal estimates for ", predictor,
              " in subgroup results; checking separate marginal summary.")
    }
  }
  if (is.null(marginal_row)) {
    marginal_row <- clinical_sg_marginal_row(marginal_result, predictor, digits)
  }
  rows <- list(marginal_row)

  # Exclude marginal rows before collecting the actual subgroups. An NA level
  # in a subgroup section may be a summary/interaction row, not a category.
  is_group <- !is_marginal & !is.na(group_ids) & nzchar(trimws(group_ids))
  if (any(!is_group & !is_marginal)) {
    warning("Unlabelled rows omitted from subgroup table for ", predictor)
  }
  sub_df <- df[is_group, , drop = FALSE]
  sub_group_ids <- group_ids[is_group]
  for (group in unique(sub_group_ids)) {
    sub <- sub_df[sub_group_ids == group, , drop = FALSE]
    level_name <- as.character(sub[[f$level]])
    is_level <- !is.na(level_name) & nzchar(trimws(level_name))
    if (!any(is_level)) {
      warning("No stratum levels for ", predictor, "/", group,
              "; subgroup omitted (interaction p-value cannot be displayed alone).")
      next
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      Subgroups = clinical_sg_display_subgroup(group), N = "", Result = "")
    for (j in which(is_level)) {
      n <- if (is.null(f$n)) "" else as.character(sub[[f$n]][j])
      if (is.na(n)) n <- ""
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        Subgroups = paste0("  ", sgtbl_level_title(level_name[j])),
        N = n,
        Result = sgtbl_ci(
          suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(sub[[f$estimate]][j]))),
          suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(sub[[f$lower]][j]))),
          suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(sub[[f$upper]][j]))),
          digits))
    }
    # Check all rows, including any interaction summary row without a level.
    p <- NA_real_
    if (!is.null(f$interaction)) {
      allp <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(sub[[f$interaction]])))
      valid <- unique(allp[is.finite(allp)])
      if (length(valid) > 1L) {
        warning("Multiple interaction p-values for ", predictor, "/", group,
                "; check source results. Showing NA to avoid misreporting.")
      } else if (length(valid)) p <- valid[1]
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      Subgroups = "p-value for interaction", N = "", Result = sgtbl_p(p))
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

clinical_sg_get <- function(name) {
  if (!exists(name, inherits = TRUE)) stop("Missing analysis result: ", name)
  get(name, inherits = TRUE)
}

clinical_sg_create_tables <- function() {
  tables <- list()
  for (response in names(clinical_sg_outcome_suffix)) {
    suffix <- clinical_sg_outcome_suffix[[response]]
    marginal <- clinical_sg_get(paste0("change_feature_", suffix, "_df"))
    tables[[response]] <- list()
    for (predictor in names(clinical_sg_feature_suffix)) {
      name <- paste0("change_", suffix, "_",
                     clinical_sg_feature_suffix[[predictor]], "_df")
      subgroup <- clinical_sg_get(name)
      tables[[response]][[predictor]] <- clinical_sg_table(
        subgroup, marginal, predictor, digits = 2)
      names(tables[[response]][[predictor]])[3] <-
        clinical_sg_outcome_labels[[response]]
    }
  }
  tables
}

clinical_sg_save_tables <- function(tables,
      path = "../intermediate/microbiome/clinical_subgroup_tables") {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (outcome in names(tables)) {
    for (predictor in names(tables[[outcome]])) {
      file <- file.path(path, paste0(outcome, "__", predictor, ".tsv"))
      write.table(tables[[outcome]][[predictor]], file,
                  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
    }
  }
  invisible(tables)
}

clinical_sg_print_tables <- function(tables) {
  for (response in names(tables)) {
    cat(paste0("##### ", clinical_sg_outcome_labels[[response]], "\n\n"))
    for (predictor in names(tables[[response]])) {
      cat(paste0("**", clinical_sg_features[[predictor]], "**\n\n"))
      tab <- tables[[response]][[predictor]]
      k <- knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", align = c("l", "r", "l"))
      k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, bootstrap_options = "condensed",
                                    full_width = FALSE)
      headings <- which(tab$Subgroups %in% c(
        "Marginal", "Gender", "Age", "Diabetes medications",
        "Cholesterol medications", "Hypertension medications", "Metformin",
        "GLP-1 receptor agonists", "SGLT2 inhibitors"))
      k <- kableExtra::row_spec(k, headings, bold = TRUE)
      cat(as.character(k), "\n\n")
    }
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r clinical-subgroup-create-tables, include=TRUE}
clinical_subgroup_tables <- clinical_sg_create_tables()
clinical_sg_save_tables(clinical_subgroup_tables)
# Example: clinical_subgroup_tables$fb_glucose$dash_index_scale
# Example: clinical_subgroup_tables$SBP$butyrate_producer_scale
```

```{r clinical-subgroup-show-tables, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
clinical_sg_print_tables(clinical_subgroup_tables)
```

*Note:* The estimates are associations between standardized changes in microbiome
features and changes in clinical measurements (95% CIs), not dietary treatment
contrasts. Interaction p-values and group-specific sample sizes come from the
existing `run_subgroup_associations()` results. Marginal estimates are taken
from the `marginal` row of those same results when available, with a fallback to
`change_feature_*_df` if needed. If results cannot be matched unambiguously,
the corresponding cell is shown as NA with a warning rather than guessing.


### Diet effects on outcome by baseline microbe

```{r glucose response to diet by baseline microbiome, include=T}

glucose_response_diet_bydash_index_gp <- 
  lmer(data=clinical_changebaseline_withbaselinemicrobegp,
       fb_glucose ~ diet*dash_index_gp  +(1|pptid) + visit,
       REML=TRUE)

glucose_response_diet_marginalmeans_DASH_bydash_index_gp <- 
  emmeans(glucose_response_diet_bydash_index_gp, 
          ~ diet*dash_index_gp, lmer.df ="satterthwaite")

glucose_global_test_DASH_bydash_index_gp <-
  test(pairs(
    contrast(emmeans(glucose_response_diet_marginalmeans_DASH_bydash_index_gp,
                     ~ diet|dash_index_gp, lmer.df ="satterthwaite"), 
             list("DASH4D vs comparison" = c(-0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5)),
             adjust='none'), 
    by=NULL),joint=TRUE)


glucose_mean_DASH_sum_bydash_index_gp <- 
  summary(contrast(glucose_response_diet_marginalmeans_DASH_bydash_index_gp,
              method=list("low" = c(-0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5,
                                    0,0,0,0,
                                    0,0,0,0),
                          "medium" = c(0,0,0,0,
                                       -0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5,
                                       0,0,0,0),
                          "high" = c(0,0,0,0,
                                     0,0,0,0,
                                     -0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5)
                          )
              )
          ) %>%
  mutate(lb = estimate - qt(0.975, df=df)*SE,
         ub = estimate + qt(0.975, df=df)*SE,
         Est = estimate,
         Variable = "DASH4D microbiome index",
         p = glucose_global_test_DASH_bydash_index_gp$p.value,
         Group = contrast)
```

## Short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) analyses

### load and clean data
```{r load and clean scfa data, include=T}

# SCFA models export results consumed by the visualization notebook.
dir.create("../intermediate/SCFA", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
## file path
SCFA_FECAL = "../data/fecal_scfas_df.csv"

scfa_fecal <- read.table(SCFA_FECAL, header=T, sep=",", row.names =1) %>%
  mutate(visit = factor(visit, levels=c("BL", "FP1", "FP2", "FP3", "FP4")),
         visit_diet = factor(visit_diet, levels=c("Pre-Intervention", "CH","CL","DH","DL"))) %>%
  mutate(visit_FP1 = as.numeric(visit == "FP1"),
         visit_FP2 = as.numeric(visit == "FP2"),
         visit_FP3 = as.numeric(visit == "FP3"),
         visit_FP4 = as.numeric(visit == "FP4"))

scfa_fecal_nobaseline <- scfa_fecal %>% filter(visit_diet != "Pre-Intervention")

scfa_fecal_nobaseline_carryover <- 
  scfa_fecal_nobaseline %>%
  arrange(pptid, visit) %>% group_by(pptid) %>%
  mutate(lagdiet = lag(visit_diet)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(lagCH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CH",1,0),
         lagCL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CL",1,0),
         lagDH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DH",1,0),
         lagDL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DL",1,0))


## file path
SCFA_PLASMA = "../data/plasma_scfas_df.csv"

scfa_plasma <- read.table(SCFA_PLASMA, header=T, sep=",", row.names =1) %>%
  mutate(visit = factor(visit, levels=c("BL", "FP1", "FP2", "FP3", "FP4")),
         visit_diet = factor(visit_diet, levels=c("Pre-Intervention", "CH","CL","DH","DL"))) %>%
  mutate(visit_FP1 = as.numeric(visit == "FP1"),
         visit_FP2 = as.numeric(visit == "FP2"),
         visit_FP3 = as.numeric(visit == "FP3"),
         visit_FP4 = as.numeric(visit == "FP4"))

scfa_plasma_nobaseline <- scfa_plasma %>% filter(visit_diet != "Pre-Intervention")

scfa_plasma_nobaseline_carryover <- 
  scfa_plasma_nobaseline %>%
  arrange(pptid, visit) %>% group_by(pptid) %>%
  mutate(lagdiet = lag(visit_diet)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(lagCH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CH",1,0),
         lagCL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "CL",1,0),
         lagDH = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DH",1,0),
         lagDL = ifelse(!is.na(lagdiet) & lagdiet == "DL",1,0))



```

### fecal SCFA: diet effect
```{r fecal scfa, include=T}

# acetate
acetate_fecal_DASH <- 
  lmer(log(acetate_fecal) ~ visit_diet + visit + (1|pptid) ,
       data=scfa_fecal_nobaseline_carryover,
       REML=TRUE)

acetate_fecal_marginalmeans_DASH <- 
  emmeans(acetate_fecal_DASH,
          ~ visit_diet, lmer.df ="satterthwaite")


acetate_fecal_mean_sum_DASH <- 
  summary(contrast(
    acetate_fecal_marginalmeans_DASH,
    method=list("DASH4D diet vs baseline" = c(0,0,0.5,0.5),
                "DASH4D diet vs baseline among low sodium" = c(0,0,0,1),
                "DASH4D diet vs baseline among high sodium" = c(0,0,1,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline" = c(0.5,0.5,0,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline among low sodium" = c(0,1,0,0),
                "Comparison diet vs baseline among high sodium" = c(1,0,0,0),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet" = c(-0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among low sodium" = c(0,-1,0,1),
                "DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among high sodium" = c(-1,0,1,0),
                "Difference in DASH4D effect in low sodium vs high sodium" = c(1,-1,-1,1),
                "low sodium vs baseline" = c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5),
                "high sodium vs baseline" = c(0.5,0,0.5,0),
                "low sodium vs high sodium" = c(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5)
                )
    )
    ) %>%
  mutate(lb = estimate - qt(0.975, df=df)*SE,
         ub = estimate + qt(0.975, df=df)*SE)
```
