### Subgroup analysis

#### Data cleaning
```{r scfa-subgroup-covariates}
add_scfa_subgroup_covariates <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      sex = factor(sex, labels = c("male", "female")),
      age_gp = factor(ifelse(age_rz < 65, 0, 1),
                      labels = c("<65 years", "65+ years")),
      diabmeds_gp = factor(case_when(diabmeds_num == 0 ~ 0,
                                     diabmeds_num == 1 ~ 1,
                                     diabmeds_num > 1 ~ 2),
                           labels = c("0", "1", "2+")),
      htnmeds_gp = factor(case_when(htnmeds_num <= 1 ~ 0,
                                    htnmeds_num == 2 ~ 1,
                                    htnmeds_num > 2 ~ 2),
                          labels = c("0-1", "2", "3+")),
      cholmeds_gp = factor(case_when(cholmeds_num == 0 ~ 0,
                                     cholmeds_num == 1 ~ 1,
                                     cholmeds_num > 1 ~ 2),
                           labels = c("0", "1", "2+")),
      glp1 = factor(glp1ra, labels = c("no", "yes")),
      sglt2 = factor(sglt2i, labels = c("no", "yes")),
      metformin = factor(metformin, labels = c("no", "yes"))
    )
}

scfa_fecal_subgroup <- add_scfa_subgroup_covariates(
  scfa_fecal_nobaseline_carryover)
scfa_plasma_subgroup <- add_scfa_subgroup_covariates(
  scfa_plasma_nobaseline_carryover)

scfa_plasma_baseline_subgroup <- add_scfa_subgroup_covariates(scfa_plasma) %>%
  filter(visit == "BL")

scfa_baseline_metabolites <- c(
  "acetate_fecal", "butyrate_fecal", "propionate_fecal", "isovalerate_fecal",
  "acetate_plasma", "butyrate_plasma", "propionate_plasma",
  "isovalerate_plasma", "succinate_plasma"
)

if (requireNamespace("table1", quietly = TRUE) &&
    all(scfa_baseline_metabolites %in% names(scfa_plasma_baseline_subgroup))) {
  my.render.cont <- function(x) {
    with(table1::stats.apply.rounding(table1::stats.default(x), digits = 2),
         c("", "Mean (SD)" = sprintf("%s (%s)", MEAN, SD)))
  }
  table1::table1(
    ~ acetate_fecal + butyrate_fecal + propionate_fecal + isovalerate_fecal +
      acetate_plasma + butyrate_plasma + propionate_plasma +
      isovalerate_plasma + succinate_plasma | sglt2,
    data = scfa_plasma_baseline_subgroup,
    overall = c(left = "Total"),
    render.continuous = my.render.cont
  )
} else {
  message("Skipping subgroup baseline table: table1 or required columns unavailable.")
}
```

#### Functions and constants for subgroup analysis
```{r scfa-subgroup-functions}
# Original contrast coding assumes the diet order CH, CL, DH, DL.
diet_effect <- c(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
sodium_effect <- c(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5)
diet_levels <- c("CH", "CL", "DH", "DL")

# Descriptive names are used for the contrast output, not to re-code data.
# Unlike the original script, hypertension groups are labeled 0-1, 2, 3+
# to agree with the values assigned in prepare_scfa_data().
subgroup_labels <- list(
  sex = list(strata = c("males", "females"), difference = "male vs female"),
  age_gp = list(strata = c("<65", "65+"), difference = "<65 vs 65+"),
  diabmeds_gp = list(strata = c("0", "1", "2+")),
  cholmeds_gp = list(strata = c("0", "1", "2+")),
  htnmeds_gp = list(strata = c("0-1", "2", "3+")),
  metformin = list(strata = c("non-metformin user", "metformin user"),
                   difference = "non-metformin user vs metformin user"),
  glp1 = list(strata = c("non-glp1 user", "glp1 user"),
              difference = "non-glp1 user vs glp1 user"),
  sglt2 = list(strata = c("non-sglt2 user", "sglt2 user"),
               difference = "non-sglt2 user vs sglt2 user")
)

# Put a four-cell contrast in the selected subgroup's block of the
# visit_diet-by-subgroup grid; fill the other blocks with zero.
in_subgroup <- function(values, index, n_groups) {
  output <- numeric(length(values) * n_groups)
  output[((index - 1) * length(values) + 1):(index * length(values))] <- values
  output
}

make_subgroup_contrasts <- function(subgroup) {
  info <- subgroup_labels[[subgroup]]
  if (is.null(info)) stop("Unknown subgroup: ", subgroup)
  labels <- info$strata
  n_groups <- length(labels)

  dash <- lapply(seq_len(n_groups), function(i) {
    in_subgroup(diet_effect, i, n_groups)
  })
  names(dash) <- paste0("DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet among ", labels)

  sodium <- lapply(seq_len(n_groups), function(i) {
    in_subgroup(sodium_effect, i, n_groups)
  })
  names(sodium) <- paste0("low sodium vs high sodium among ", labels)

  # Two-level analyses include the difference between subgroup effects.
  if (n_groups == 2) {
    dash_difference <- list(dash[[1]] - dash[[2]])
    names(dash_difference) <- paste0("DASH4D diet vs Comparison diet ",
                                      info$difference)
    sodium_difference <- list(sodium[[1]] - sodium[[2]])
    names(sodium_difference) <- paste0("low sodium vs high sodium ",
                                        info$difference)
    return(c(dash, dash_difference, sodium, sodium_difference))
  }

  # Three-level analyses use within-stratum contrasts only, as originally coded.
  c(dash, sodium)
}

# For three-level groups, reproduce the original joint heterogeneity tests
# comparing subgroup-specific diet or sodium contrasts across groups.
run_global_test <- function(model, subgroup, contrast_values, contrast_name) {
  means_by_group <- emmeans(
    model, specs = as.formula(paste("~ visit_diet |", subgroup)),
    lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
  test(pairs(contrast(means_by_group,
                      method = setNames(list(contrast_values), contrast_name),
                      adjust = "none"),
             by = NULL),
       joint = TRUE)
}

run_scfa_subgroup <- function(data, metabolite, subgroup) {
  info <- subgroup_labels[[subgroup]]
  if (is.null(info)) stop("Unknown subgroup: ", subgroup)
  if (!metabolite %in% names(data)) stop("Unknown metabolite: ", metabolite)
  if (!subgroup %in% names(data)) stop("Missing subgroup: ", subgroup)

  # Same fitted model as the original: log outcome, diet-by-subgroup
  # interaction, visit adjustment, pptid random intercept, REML = TRUE.
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste0(
    "log(", metabolite, ") ~ visit_diet * ", subgroup,
    " + visit + (1 | pptid)"))
  model <- lmer(model_formula, data = data, REML = TRUE)

  means <- emmeans(model,
                   specs = as.formula(paste0("~ visit_diet * ", subgroup)),
                   lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

  # Guard against accidentally applying the original hard-coded contrast
  # weights to a differently ordered or incomplete estimated-marginal-means grid.
  grid <- as.data.frame(means)
  n_groups <- length(info$strata)
  expected_levels <- levels(data[[subgroup]])
  if (length(expected_levels) != n_groups ||
      nrow(grid) != 4 * n_groups ||
      !identical(as.character(grid$visit_diet), rep(diet_levels, n_groups)) ||
      !identical(as.character(grid[[subgroup]]), rep(expected_levels, each = 4))) {
    stop("Unexpected emmeans order or number of factor levels for ",
         metabolite, " / ", subgroup,
         "; inspect the marginal-means grid before applying contrasts.")
  }

  contrast_summary <- summary(contrast(
    means, method = make_subgroup_contrasts(subgroup))) %>%
    mutate(lb = estimate - qt(0.975, df = df) * SE,
           ub = estimate + qt(0.975, df = df) * SE) %>%
    mutate(estimate = exp(estimate),
           lb = exp(lb), ub = exp(ub))

  global_tests <- NULL
  if (n_groups == 3) {
    global_tests <- list(
      DASH = run_global_test(model, subgroup, diet_effect,
                             "DASH4D vs Comparison"),
      sodium = run_global_test(model, subgroup, sodium_effect,
                               "low sodium vs high sodium")
    )
  }

  list(model = model, marginal_means = means,
       contrasts = contrast_summary, global_tests = global_tests)
}

run_scfa_panel <- function(data, metabolites, subgroups = names(subgroup_labels)) {
  # Access: results[[subgroup]][[metabolite]]$contrasts
  setNames(lapply(subgroups, function(group) {
    setNames(lapply(metabolites, function(name) {
      run_scfa_subgroup(data, name, group)
    }), metabolites)
  }), subgroups)
}
```

#### Fecal and plasma subgroup analyses
```{r scfa-run-subgroups}
fecal_metabolites <- c("acetate", "butyrate", "propionate", "isovalerate")
plasma_metabolites <- c("acetate", "butyrate", "propionate",
                       "isovalerate", "succinate")

scfa_subgroup_results <- list(
  fecal = run_scfa_panel(scfa_fecal_subgroup,
                         paste0(fecal_metabolites, "_fecal")),
  plasma = run_scfa_panel(scfa_plasma_subgroup,
                          paste0(plasma_metabolites, "_plasma"))
)

# Example: sex-stratified acetate results in fecal samples.
# scfa_subgroup_results$fecal$sex$acetate_fecal$contrasts
# scfa_subgroup_results$fecal$sex$acetate_fecal$model
# Example: global tests for plasma acetate by hypertension medication group.
# scfa_subgroup_results$plasma$htnmeds_gp$acetate_plasma$global_tests
```

#### SCFA subgroup result tables
```{r scfa-subgroup-compile-tables, include=TRUE}
scfa_tables_fecal <- sgtbl_make_panel(
  scfa_subgroup_results$fecal, scfa_fecal_subgroup,
  paste0(fecal_metabolites, "_fecal"), rep(2, length(fecal_metabolites)),
  diet_var = "visit_diet", exponentiate = TRUE, log_response = TRUE)
scfa_tables_plasma <- sgtbl_make_panel(
  scfa_subgroup_results$plasma, scfa_plasma_subgroup,
  paste0(plasma_metabolites, "_plasma"), rep(2, length(plasma_metabolites)),
  diet_var = "visit_diet", exponentiate = TRUE, log_response = TRUE)

scfa_subgroup_tables <- list(
  DASH = c(scfa_tables_fecal$DASH, scfa_tables_plasma$DASH),
  sodium = c(scfa_tables_fecal$sodium, scfa_tables_plasma$sodium)
)
sgtbl_save(scfa_subgroup_tables, "../intermediate/SCFA/subgroup_tables")
# Examples:
# scfa_subgroup_tables$DASH$acetate_fecal
# sgtbl_one_subgroup(scfa_subgroup_tables$DASH$acetate_fecal, "sex")
```

```{r scfa-subgroup-show-tables, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
sgtbl_print(scfa_subgroup_tables)
```

*Note:* N represents unique participants in each fitted model. SCFA estimates
are exponentiated ratios (95% CI). Interaction p-values come from the existing
subgroup model contrasts or joint interaction tests; marginal estimates come
from the corresponding models without subgroup interaction terms.
